paragraph_1.text: But here’s the chicken-and-egg problem. What if you’re so far inside the child-state that you can’t become the adult? This is much easier when you can already reach one of those adult roles. But when you can't, it's like you sit there trying to be loving while your mind is becoming controlled again by the inherited critic voice, or you start going numb, throwing a fit, or panicking.
paragraph_1.owner_reported_result: Human / low confidence; checked four times

paragraph_2.text: I think the missing first phase is borrowed adulthood. Before you can reliably become the inner parent, you may need to borrow one adult function first. Maybe you experience it with somebody, maybe you imagine it, maybe you copy what you've seen. Then you practice some of it with help and start doing little pieces yourself. Over time, you don't have to borrow as much.
